description: Moves all cards from a source Trello list to a destination list on a specified board. This moves the cards rather than copying them.

idBoard.description: The ID of the destination Trello board to which all cards from the source list will be moved. This parameter is required by Trello for this operation.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idList.description: The ID of the source Trello list from which all cards will be moved. This is used in the path parameter.
idList.title: Id List

idListDestination.description: The ID of the destination Trello list on the destination board to which all cards from the source list will be moved. This parameter is required by Trello for this operation.
idListDestination.title: Id List Destination
